div.div:
LDAP / AD / Kerberos
• directory the IdP queries for users & groups
• LDAP bind = app re-checks password (LDAPS only!)
• Kerberos = ticket-based Windows internal SSO
• backends behind the IdP — not an API concern

div.div:
Federation pitfalls
• trust IdP groups → map to roles via allowlist
• validate iss, aud, signature every time
• exact-match ACS / redirect URLs
• offboarding: disable → access dies within token TTL
